text: "The upcoming election day, taking place on Tuesday, offers families a chance to spend time together as a holiday. Many businesses and companies are offering special deals and discounts for Election Day, hoping to attract voters. The Azrieli Mall group is offering a variety of products for only $17 from selected stores. The Seven Stars Mall in Herzliya will host a free activity day with a performance by Guy Friedman, a baking workshop, and a cooking workshop for children. The Renanim Mall in Ra'anana will set up a free snow area with activities for the whole family. The Savion Mall will host a special used goods market where children can sell their toys. Many fashion retailers are offering significant discounts for Election Day, including Castro, ZIP, Ronen Chen, and Factory 54. Furniture and electronics stores are also joining in on the deals, including Good Night, Mashbir, Shakam Electric, Carpet City, American Comfort, and Amican Center. Coffee shops Lavita will give away free coffee to anyone who shows an inked voting finger. The Hamat Gader resort will offer a 25% discount on entrance to the complex. The Mashbir Department Store will offer an additional 20% off all items, in addition to existing sales. Laline is offering 30% off for members and new members, or three items for $99. BurgerBar will offer a free side dish (fries, onion rings, or salad) with any meal purchase. Energy Sports, Fitness, and Spa Club ZEUS will offer free entry and unlimited use of their facilities from 8 AM to 6 PM. The Mamas and Papas travel store will offer up to 60% off luggage and bags, and a 1+1 deal on travel accessories. The ZEUS Sports, Fitness, and Spa Club will offer free entry and unlimited use of their facilities from 8 AM to 6 PM"
claim: The Hamat Gader resort will not offer a 25% discount on entrance to the complex.
label: INCORRECT
